subject: Science
description: The human eye in section: cornea, iris, pupil, lens, retina, optic nerve
alt: A side section of the human eye showing the cornea at the front, the iris and pupil, the lens, the retina at the back and the optic nerve leaving it
prompt: A horizontal side section of the human eye, front (cornea) on the left. A transparent domed cornea, the iris as two flaps either side of the round pupil, a biconvex lens just behind it, a large round eyeball chamber, the retina lining the back (in the orange accent), and the optic nerve leaving the back to the right.
checklist: the cornea is a bulge at the front, the lens sits behind the iris and pupil
the lens is biconvex and centred on the pupil
the retina lines the back inside surface and the optic nerve leaves from the back
the eyeball is round and its parts are in the correct front-to-back order
